== Update, July 8, 2026 ==

=== Skill adjustments ===
*{{P}} Paragon
** {{skill icon|Mighty Throw}}: Split skill into PvE/PvP versions.
** {{skill icon|Mighty Throw}} (PvP): Changed recharge time from 0 to 2.
** {{skill icon|Unblockable Throw}}: Changed recharge time from 0 to 1.
* Underworld
** {{skill icon|Dhuum's Rest}}: Reduced recharge time from 5 to 4.

=== Bug fixes ===
* Fixed issues with audio sometimes not stopping or restarting when switching away and back to the mobile apps.
* Error codes are now displayed when in-app purchase failures occur.
* Fixed an issue where some one-time in-app purchases appeared to be repurchasable immediately after purchasing them.
* Updated {{skill icon|Kinetic Armor}} description to match functionality. Previously the text was hardcoded instead of properly derived from the code.
** The description should now read: ''“For 12 seconds, you gain +20..80 armor. Whenever you cast a spell, Kinetic Armor is renewed for 12 seconds.”''
** Concise description: ''“(12 seconds.) You have +20..80 armor. Renewal bonus: cast a spell.”''

=== Guild Wars Wiki notes ===
* Build: 38,734.
